standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3668-3672) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the presenting morphism locally of finite type.

standard_prerequisites.name: The composition permanence of locally of finite type morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3673-3674)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the residue field point through the presentation into a locally finite type morphism.

standard_prerequisites.name: The existence of finite type points on a nonempty algebraic space of locally finite type over a field
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3678-3681) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a finite type point of the fibre of the presentation.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the image of a finite type point under a morphism of finite type is again a finite type point, and the description of finite type points of a scheme through closed points
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked near the end of the counted proof (source lines 3682-3690) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the point can be assumed to be a closed point of the presentation.

core_obligations: (2) implies (1): the residue field point of the presentation is of finite type and the presentation is representable and locally of finite type, so the composite is locally of finite type and represents the point (proof lines 3667-3674)

(1) implies (2): the fibre of the presentation over the given point is an algebraic space locally of finite type over the residue field, so it has a finite type point; its image in the presentation is a finite type point, and after shrinking the presentation that point may be assumed closed (proof lines 3675-3693)
proof_roadmap: (2)⇒(1)：Spec(κ(u)) → U 有限型，U → X 可表示且局部有限型 ⇒ 复合局部有限型并代表 x。
(1)⇒(2)：取满光滑 U → X，则 U ×_X Spec(k) 在 k 上局部有限型 ⇒ 有有限型点 v；其像 u ∈ U 是有限型点 ⇒ 缩 U 可设 u 是闭点。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a point of an algebraic stack is of finite type exactly when it can be represented by a locally finite type morphism from the spectrum of a field, which is also equivalent to being the image of a closed point under a smooth morphism from a scheme (author lemma at source lines 3655-3665, label lemma-point-finite-type). The proof (source lines 3667-3694) proves the easy direction by composition permanence and the converse by producing a finite type point in the fibre of a presentation and pushing it down to a closed point after shrinking (proof lines 3667-3693). The production of the finite type point in the fibre is the substance. H3.
